status: MP16 PROTOTYPE - J2 / J3 common drive module (NEMA23 + SERVO57D -> HTD 3M belt 20T:60T -> printed cycloid 28 pins / 27 lobes = 81:1). Purchased-part sizes are the listing / nominal values of the parts in the user's cart (2026-11-06) - measure on arrival and recalibrate (user: 「오기전에 모델링은 끝내놔 치수보정은 나중에 한다고해도」)
frame: z = joint (reducer) axis; z 0 = HOUSING_BASE bottom face; output +z; belt / pulley side -z. Motor axis at x = +belt.centre_distance, y 0 (side layout - user 「옆 배치 (권장)」). Input angle theta: cam 1 eccentric direction; disc 1 centre = E (cos theta, sin theta), disc 2 = opposite; carrier = -theta / 27.

ring.source: pin = cart 「HZYUEGOU M1~M8 cylindrical dowel pin 10pcs M6/45mm」 (304 stainless, GB119) - nominal; radius = author (sizing.py)

output_pins.source: R1 review: 45 (the cart had 40) - pressed 19 deep in the carrier instead of 14 (cantilever entrance pressure); hardened (ISO 8734 class) preferred over the cart 304 - user to change the cart option

shaft.source: not yet in the cart (608 - common; the user has used 608 before - BOM M08)

bearings.ring_note: same rule as MP6: a shoulder stays clear of the other ring using factor and overlaps its own ring inside the min_factor band

shaft.status: cart 「DIY 모델용 2Pcs 8mm D 모양 샤프트 직경 8mm 길이 100mm 플랫 액슬」 - cut to 81 AFTER measuring the 60T pulley (R1: do not cut first); top flush with the upper 608, up to 2 longer is fine; flat_to_axis is an ASSUMPTION (not on the listing) - measure on arrival

pulley_envelope.note: ASSUMPTION - flange diameter and hub length are not on the listing. R1: the belt plane is low (centre -18) so a hubbed 20T can sit hub-up (hub between the teeth and the plate, set screw on the shaft) and a hubless one still has shaft at its set screw; the 60T hub (if any) goes down - the envelopes cover both

motor.source: listing drawings (user screenshots 2026-11-06): MKS SERVO57D 56 mm / 76 mm motor, shaft 8 / flat 7.5, shaft 25 (56 mm) and 24 (76 mm), board 14.1; frame · bolt square · pilot = NEMA23 common values (ASSUMPTION)

cap.note: R1: the 6812 sits above the ring pin tops so the 45 deg cone over the discs starts above the pin grooves (a cone meeting the grooves gave an open STL) - cap printed upright; cap and hub faces 0.2 under the 6812 ring faces so the retainer and the flange clamp the rings

cam.note: R1: the upper cam top collar is centred on its lobe (r 11.5) so it holds the 6804 #2 inner ring down; the washer (on the axis) sits on it

guard.note: tab angles = half a pin pitch between ring pins (pins every 360/28 deg) so the base inserts clear the pin holes; the motor-end tab is a through hole + M3 nut on the lobe top

stand.note: bench pose: axis horizontal, motor up (+x up), desk at x = -axis_height; the stand plate sits on the cap top face (z 62) and the module hangs behind it

lever.note: R1: the 20 x 6 arm was about 38 MPa at the root with the nominal J2 torque on the 200 mm hook - now 36 (in plane) x 12; print 100 % infill; swing only the lower half (pointing up the arm meets the motor)

fits_from.note: Ø6 / Ø8 pin holes = pin + (ledger pin_press_hole_dia - 4.0) / + (pin_slip_hole_dia - 4.0) - the Ø4 oversize carried over (ASSUMPTION until a coupon); bearing seats + bearing_seat_extra; shafts into inner rings + bearing_bore_extra; D bores + d_bore_extra; inserts = insert_hole_dia; M3 clearance = m3_clearance_dia
